entities.name: Sergeant Usman
entities.description: Seasoned Fallaji soldier who fought for Mishra and aided Farid's team outside Tomakul.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Leader on whose side Usman fought.

entities.name: Farid
entities.description: Leader of a small group Usman helped outside Tomakul.

entities.name: Tomakul
entities.description: City outside which the trench war took place.

entities.name: Tomakul Campaign
entities.description: Campaign in 44 AR in which Usman participated.

events.summary: Usman waited an hour for Farid during the trench war outside Tomakul.
events.quote: he waited for Farid for an hour

events.summary: Usman gave Farid's team satchels and an order chit in exchange for a full satchel of goods.
events.quote: Usman provided Farid and his team with soft satchels and a crucial order chit

events.summary: Usman directed Farid to the trench ladder and watched them depart.
events.quote: Usman remained behind, watching their departure with approval and expectation

relations.quote: Sergeant Usman was a Fallaji soldier who fought on the side of Mishra in the Brothers' War
